name: Shiro
source:
"Taro... what do you think of... this mansion?"

A mysterious girl who lives in the mansion with the sisters. Though she keeps a poker face on almost all the time, she starts showing her friendly side more after [url=/c34812]Taro[/url] comes to live into the mansion, and begins to bond with him due to having to do the same work as him. Due to Shiro having a weak presence, almost nobody outside the mansion remembers her, nor does know about her.

[Translated from [url=http://www.getchu.com/soft.phtml?id=629165]Getchu[/url]]
